'''Cosamelle''' is a town in [[Ghealdan]].

==History==
When [[Logain Ablar]] is relating his fall from power to [[Altaran]] [[Nobility|nobles]], he claims that six [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Red Ajah]] met him in Cosamelle. That group included [[Javindhra Doraille]], the leader, and [[Barasine]]. They supposedly threatened him with death if he did not pose as a [[false Dragon]].{{ref/book|6|8}}
